……なんだかより悪い方へ転がっていく気がするが、まあ、今の遠坂と話す以上の危険なんてないので良しとしよう。

“W-Wait just a minute! I haven’t finished talking to you…!”

I shake off the demon’s voice behind me and race into the corridor.

…I have a feeling this will only make matters worse. Still, nothing could be more dangerous than talking to Tohsaka in her present mood, so I will call it the right decision.
pages.mirrorMoon:
“H-Hold on, I’m not done yet…!”
I ignore her and run into the hallway.
…I think I’m making things worse, but there’s nothing more dangerous than talking to her right now.

Shinji’s desk is empty.

Facing him the very next day would have been painful, but I wanted to settle things between us.

There is nothing I can do if he is absent. Going to the Matou house would only provoke him, so I will have to find some way to keep Sakura out of this.

あれは一成の机だ。

自分の机に鞄を置いて、来るべきホームルームに備える。

“…Wait. What?”

There is another empty desk.

Issei’s.

“That’s unusual. Even he misses school sometimes.”

I place my bag on my desk and prepare for the approaching homeroom period.

“Sorry to keep you waiting! Well? This has to be a new morning record!”

For once, Fuji arrives before the homeroom bell.

…That is something of a relief.

When she failed to appear this morning, I assumed she had overslept. But she is even more energetic than usual. Honestly.

“Sorry to keep you all waiting! Isn’t this a new record!?”
Fuji-nee arriving before the bell rings is a rare spectacle indeed.
…I’m relieved.
I thought she slept in since she didn’t come to my house this morning, but she’s more energetic than usual.

The instant lunch break begins, a war cry rises from the center of the classroom.

Only the boys describe lunch in such bloodthirsty terms. The girls shift their desks toward the four corners to escape them.

“Hey, that’s rude! I can make an omelet. You just pour water on it and heat it up. Isn’t that right, Emiya-kun?”

It is time for our appointment.

I do not know what Tohsaka is planning, but students still remain in the building. The archery club will be practicing until five. If the worst happens, I can escape somewhere crowded.

Tohsaka is a proper mage. She should not attack me where anyone might see.

Miyama is, as its name suggests, a town built among the mountains.

Slopes cross it here and there, and some of the roads lead into small mountains of their own.

Miyama City is located in a valley between mountains.
There are hills all over town, and there are roads that lead up to small mountains.

よって、裏側に回ればすぐに山の雑木林に出る事になる。

This school occupies one of them.

It stands halfway up the mountainside, and naturally, the land beyond it has never been developed.

Go around behind the buildings and you immediately enter a wooded mountain slope.
